2: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments, according to Sheminith. A Psalm of David. O LORD, do not rebuke me in Your anger or discipline me in Your wrath.
3: Be merciful to me, O LORD, for I am frail; heal me, O LORD, for my bones are in agony.
4: My soul is deeply distressed. How long, O LORD, how long?
5: Turn, O LORD, and deliver my soul; save me because of Your loving devotion.
6: For there is no mention of You in death; who can praise You from Sheol?
7: I am weary from groaning; all night I flood my bed with weeping and drench my couch with tears.
8: My eyes fail from grief; they grow dim because of all my foes.
9: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for the LORD has heard my weeping.
10: The LORD has heard my cry for mercy; the LORD accepts my prayer.
11: All my enemies will be ashamed and dismayed; they will turn back in sudden disgrace.
